prompts.scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background atlas for an offline children's Andean educational geometry game in Godot. Create FOUR distinct wide environments in an EXACT TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW grid. Full sheet 16:9 landscape and each quadrant also a full wide 16:9 background; no borders, no gutters. TOP LEFT: a warm colorful Andean architect's craft workshop, terracotta village and snow mountains outside the windows, woven textiles and flowers at the edges, broad clean pale wooden central play space. TOP RIGHT: an inviting Andean exploration garden and cobblestone plaza with lush flowers, bright trees at the far sides, distant mountain village, broad uncluttered central lawn for finding game pieces. BOTTOM LEFT: a lovely textile-weaving festival courtyard with colorful woven fabrics and a large empty wooden loom along the far sides, sunlit clear central pale space where interactive pattern pieces will be drawn; do not draw the learning pieces. BOTTOM RIGHT: sweeping magical aerial Andean valley with layered blue mountains, bright blue sky and soft white clouds, green terraces and distant village low along the bottom; generous open central sky for a flying balloon game, no aircraft or balloons. Premium polished colorful 3D family animation storybook game art with tactile rich materials and warm light, compatible with a cream fluffy llama wearing a bright Andean poncho. Calm playable centers with saturated decorative accents. Constraints: NO characters, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO buttons, NO user interface, NO watermarks, NO decorative geometry targets that could be mistaken for puzzle answers. Four reusable environment plates, not app screenshots or mockups.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final transparent object sprite atlas for a colorful Andean educational geometry game. An EXACT FOUR COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, eight equally sized square cells, full image twice as wide as tall. Exactly one isolated complete object centered inside each cell with generous transparent padding. Reading order: 1 a plain smooth natural wooden toy CUBE with equal edge lengths, a simple visible three-quarter view, no markings; 2 a shiny round toy BALL with a turquoise and coral stripe, spherical and inviting; 3 a clean small golden metal food CAN with circular top and bottom, no label, cylinder silhouette; 4 a festive purple and orange PARTY HAT with a circular base and pointed top, simple cone silhouette; 5 a cheerful turquoise and orange HOT AIR BALLOON, full canopy, ropes and empty woven basket, centered and fully contained in cell, enough open basket room for a small game character; 6 a small empty wooden Andean WEAVING LOOM with colorful vertical threads and an open pale center, no woven pattern pieces; 7 a green explorer FLAG on a short wooden pole with a tiny woven tassel; 8 a golden COMPASS achievement medallion with turquoise ribbon, no letters. Premium tactile polished 3D family animation toy rendering, warm consistent upper-left light, visually compatible with an Andean children's game and fluffy cream llama. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha outside objects and between all cells. No ground plane, no opaque backdrop or shadows, no square panels, no text, no numerals, no watermarks, no extra objects. Actual game sprites, not an illustrated poster.
